sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the use of methocarbamol during breastfeeding. If a mother requires methocarbamol, it is not a reason to discontinue breastfeeding. Monitor the infant for sedation, poor feeding and poor weight gain.
